_comment: Full weekly CommitFest snapshots, archived by the compaction pass in the weekly-dbms-digest skill. This file is history only -- it is not read during a normal run. references/commitfest-state.json keeps the single most recent full snapshot plus a one-line {week, cf, created_n, closed_n, net} summary for every earlier week; this file has the full original object for all of them, including the one still kept in full in the live file.

weeks.cf: PG20-1 (#59), In Progress Jul 1-31 (review month); new patches land in PG20-2 (#61)
weeks.note: No browser this run. CF app cache-stale again: a search-surfaced /59/ snapshot showed only 3 committed / 287 total, which is an early-July cache inconsistent with the 2026-07-13 reading (153 committed / 613 total) and must NOT be used. Weekly flow NOT measurable; resume deltas at next live read. Commit ground-truth from pgsql-committers (thread index fresh through Jul 26, msg47430-47528 in-window) shows heavy activity concentrated in logical replication (sequence sync take-two after last week's revert, subscription owner/conninfo, pre-PG19 publisher guard), nbtree SSI/predicate-lock hardening + test coverage (Peter Geoghegan), REPACK beta polish (Alvaro Herrera), and a pgstats out-of-memory hardening run (Michael Paquier). postgresql.org news posted nothing after Jul 16 (PG19 Beta 2).

PARTIAL, by data retention rather than access. Both the global /activity/ and the per-CF /61/activity/ logs were reached and were fresh, but each keeps only its last ~100 rows with no pagination. The best snapshot (global log, captured 2026-08-10) reached back to 2026-08-05 05:44; by 2026-08-11 the per-CF log started even later (Aug 5 19:19). Aug 3-4 had already rolled off and is unrecoverable - a browser would not have helped. LESSON: capture CF flow early in the week. Reaching /<n>/activity/ requires fetching the CF detail page first: /<n>/?tag=<any> is small (unlike the bare /<n>/) and its 'Activity log' link puts the URL into the fetch provenance set. Queue totals above come from the authoritative 'Status summary' line on that page. Open CF is PG20-2 (#61); PG20-1 (#59) has closed. No 2026-07-20 or 2026-07-27 snapshot exists, so no week-over-week delta was reported.
